description: Use this when the user asks whether a contractor price or quote is fair, or what a job typically costs in their area (US). Compares against real quotes we collected for the same job type in the same 3-digit ZIP region. Returns the median, sample size and, if quoted_usd is given, a verdict (low, fair, high). Free. The full low/typical/high distribution is on the x402 endpoint GET https://rebidpro.com/agent/v1/price-check ($0.25).

job_type.description: Job type id from list_job_types, e.g. water_heater_replace

quoted_usd.description: The price the user was quoted, in US dollars

zip.description: ZIP code of the property (3 or 5 digits)

name: check_fair_price
title: Check if a contractor price is fair
